brand:

nav: three.js twinMappedin
hint: Mappedin SDK · drag to pan · right-drag to rotate · scroll to zoom · click any room or exhibit
footer_note: The map is rendered by the Mappedin JS SDK from an MVF bundle generated straight from the venue brief: 5 floors, 98 spaces, 59 doors, 66 exhibit objects, 7 lifts, escalators and stairs, and a 213-node walk network with one-way ticket gates. No Maker drawing and no API key: room colours, labels, markers, step-free directions and paths are driven live by the same agent scenarios as the three.js twins. In production the same bundle would come from Maker or the Mappedin API.
